evidence.why: Initial overwrite, unguarded division and final Z assignment.

facts.rationale: Adds the cross-file lifecycle precondition, mixed identifier provenance and callback lifetime that are important when reading these otherwise similar wrappers.
facts.value: selected_stage starts as Izumi with a null entry. Stage_802251E8 establishes the cached map-entry pointer; subsequent runtime-init, load, start and demo wrappers dereference it without a guard. Start/demo use that cached GrKind together with the caller's StKind rather than remapping the supplied StKind. Each StageIdPair is local to the call; inspected Ground load/start/demo dispatchers consume it synchronously. Ground startup invokes on_start, drains and frees deferred callback nodes, clears the queue, and creates common stage processing.
